digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions mirror CI scheduling and main-health reporting
problem_keywords: ci red x on healthy main
propositions: Workflows on push to main with concurrency.cancel-in-progress: true render cancelled runs as red X, making a healthy main appear broken on GitHub
Mirror main CI must shift from per-commit push triggers to scheduled runs every 6 hours to avoid cancellation noise while preserving pre-merge Gerrit Verified gating
Last-known-green SHA resolution from Actions API and git bisect run recipe must be published to workflow summary for safe multi-commit regression diagnosis
External integration jobs must not increase frequency beyond once-per-day; prompt-eval and codeql cadence must not increase from current scheduled rates
All six main-facing workflows must have explicit disposition: branches-ignore main, drop push, or add schedule; every workflow must support workflow_dispatch for on-demand health checks
Trigger policy enforcement and report rendering must be unit-testable via scripts/main_health_report.py with injected gh Runner, not inline workflow YAML
